gamerule.cozy_core:mob_explosions_break_: Creeper and ghast explosions break blocks
Off: their explosions still hurt, but leave every block standing. TNT and the wither are unchanged.
Off: endermen leave your blocks where they are.
gamerule.cozy_core:fire_burns_blocks.des: Off: fire still appears and goes out, but never catches a block alight or burns one away.
On: your hotbar, armour and off-hand stay with you when you die; everything else drops where you fell. Vanilla's keepInventory keeps everything and wins when it's on.
gamerule.cozy_core:hearth_lantern_radius: How many blocks around a Hearth Lantern, at any height, monsters don't spawn naturally. 0 switches the lanterns off.
